description: Reference-based refinement of the provisional canonical face (Exp 001 seed 1001): hazel irises, right-cheekbone beauty mark, left-forehead scar, while preserving identity. Compares two edit models.

reference_image.label: REFERENCE 001/1001
reference_image.source: Experiment 001, Z-Image Turbo, seed 1001, 1152x1536. Baseline; never modified.

arms.name: flux2pro
arms.settings_note: Custom size identical to the reference (3:4). safety_tolerance and enable_safety_checker left at fal defaults.

arms.name: nanobananapro
arms.settings_note: No custom pixel size; 3:4 preset. 2K chosen over 1K (same $0.15 price) because 1K is below the reference's 1.77 MP and would understate skin and mark detail. Accepts a seed but does not return one. safety_tolerance left at fal default.

acceptance_rules: Identity preservation vs 1001 >= 4/5 AND photorealism >= 4/5 are both mandatory.
Identity takes priority over cosmetic changes: an image with both marks but a noticeably changed face is rejected.

Hazel eyes, beauty mark (subject's right cheekbone = viewer's left) and scar (subject's upper-left forehead = viewer's right) are secondary; missing or faint marks do not fail an otherwise accepted image.
Reject if more artificial or glamorous than 1001.
Winning model becomes the preferred portrait refinement tool only; full-body performance is evaluated separately.
